name: List event dates
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the calendar dates on which events are scheduled within a specific date range and timezone. Use the broader "events.list" action if you need full event details rather than just the dates.

startDate.description: Start of the date range (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End of the date range (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

items.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which at least one event is scheduled.

outputs.description: List of dates that have events within the requested range.
